description: This file defines an Angular service called ApiService that acts as a wrapper around Angular's HttpClient. It provides methods for common HTTP operations (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) with a predefined base URL from the environment configuration, ensuring centralized API URL management.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: An Angular injectable service that encapsulates HttpClient HTTP methods and prefixes requests with a base URL from environment config.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the API using the provided endpoint and options.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the API with specified body and options.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs a PUT request to the API with specified body and options.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Performs a PATCH request to the API with specified body and options.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to the API using the specified endpoint and options.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Constructs a full URL by joining the base API URL with the endpoint, handling slashes appropriately.
